sample.label_rule: DIRECT = the record's own subject is a patient-monitoring device, a physiological measurement or its engineering/performance, or a regulatory action about such a device. TRANSFER = non-monitoring technology whose stated purpose is patient monitoring. CLINICAL = medical research whose subject is clinical care/outcome and which merely uses monitoring data. MEDICAL_UNRELATED = medical but not about monitoring technology. NON_MEDICAL = the subject is not a patient at all. Feed-relevant = DIRECT, or TRANSFER with an explicit monitoring purpose.
sample.labelled_by: single reviewer (the REFOUNDATION-004 agent) reading the record title, and the abstract where the source provided one, against the frozen label rule before any rule change. This is an auditable machine-assisted adjudication, not an independent human panel.

sampling_frame.inference_limit: Disproportionate stratified sample of one corpus snapshot. It estimates the precision/recall of the rules on records like these; it is not a random sample of all medical-technology publications and cannot estimate the population prevalence of monitoring technology.
sampling_frame.method: fixed-seed random draw within each stratum, without replacement

window.note: The evaluator and the product default feed both use 30 days; QA-002 found the development evaluator used 14.
